purpose: Source-bound draft assertions for the seven existing canonical skincare Product IDs. This is an intake payload, not accepted ProductKnowledge and not a Product Master import.
rules: Every assertion is a draft and must be written through the existing ResearchDraft/Evidence service, never direct SQL.
All assertions remain qa_status=PENDING, evidence_status=UNKNOWN, evidence_strength=UNVERIFIED until explicit human review.
Only source-disclosed facts are recorded as manufacturer/retailer assertions. Analyst ingredient-role mappings are INFERENCE and must not be represented as finished-product efficacy.
Unknown physical package, market, GTIN, lot, and formula match remain UNKNOWN. Do not edit Product Master identity or packaging_version.
No contraindication is inferred from fragrance presence or ingredient presence alone. No unsupported contraindication or treatment indication is supplied.

The P4 international/Korean sunscreen formula is separate from the US drug-label formula. P6 historical Clinique 100 ml is separate from the replacement serum. P7 serum is separate from the Anua pads.
